34-12-4 All agreements for an exchange and/or renewal must be made prior to June 1 for the next succeeding school year.

34-12-5 Teachers approved for exchange transfer will be considered as a part of the faculty of the school from which they came for such matters as determining involuntary transferees, etc., except when such exchanges become permanent.
